name: 劇場などの車いす用客席の設置基準を定める
summary: 東京都の条例改正を踏まえ、区の条例を改正します。劇場などの客席に設ける、車いすを使う人向けの部分について、設置などの基準を定めます。施行日は令和8年10月1日です。
changes: 劇場などの客席に設ける車いす使用者用部分の設置基準を定める
who: 劇場などの施設を整備する事業者
why: 東京都の条例改正を踏まえるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Sets standards for wheelchair seating in theaters and similar venues
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Ordinance for Promoting Welfare-Friendly Community Development
en.summary: In light of amendments to an ordinance of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, the ward will amend its ordinance. It will set standards for providing areas for people who use wheelchairs in audience seating at theaters and similar venues. The ordinance will take effect on October 1, 2026.
changes: Sets standards for providing areas for wheelchair users in audience seating at theaters and similar venues
who: Businesses that develop facilities such as theaters, and people who use wheelchairs
en.why: The ward says this is to reflect amendments to an ordinance of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government.
